_comment: One-way ratchet, same convention as test-fixtures/budgets.json. Raise a floor only in the commit that delivers the improvement; never lower one to make a red run green. Floors stay at 0 until a measured baseline exists — see the note below.
_status: UNCALIBRATED. Requires a live Meilisearch + Ollama (bge-m3) to measure. Run src/scripts/test_search_relevance.sh against origin/main to record the baseline, then against this branch, then set minRecallAt10 / minMrr to ~95% of the post-change numbers. The mustBeInTop assertions in queries.json gate regardless of these floors.
